title: The Second Part of the Chronicle of Peru
authors: Clements R. Markham, translator and editor
version: Hakluyt Society English translation; Project Gutenberg HTML
lineage: Digitized English translation of a colonial manuscript, not the original sixteenth-century manuscript; exact textual transmission and later edition details are distinct.

passages.note: Describes provincial messengers, relay posts and the handoff of messages; account is retrospective and based on local statements.
Distinguishes the 1553 first part from second-part editions printed in 1873 and 1880.
